summary.en: Professor Agasa, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys attend a firefly festival to commemorate a shinto shrine in a small mountain village of Kofu, Yamanashi Prefecture. The truck soon arrives with the fireflies and they are released into the fields. Later one of the truck drivers, Tokuro Nakamine, is found murdered and three of the villagers are the prime suspects. Location: Eboshi Rock Victim: Tokuro Nakamine Cause of death: Cyanide poisoning Suspects: Aoi Owada, Tatsuma Kashiwa, and Shuichiro Tarumi Professor Agasa drives the Beetle with Conan, Tarumi, and Michitake to the Eboshi rock, founding Tokuro is dead in his Lancer EVO X. Conan notices a flashlight Genta found inside the truck and realizes who the murderer is.
